scientific_integrity: Exact finite-state symbolic proof and replayable Python/SymPy certificate, with independent unlumped rational checks at r=2 and 3. No claim of independent external validation or novel generic crossover existence.
scientific_limitations: Strictly advantageous fitness r>1, death-first biased voter updating, two seeds and connected finite simple undirected graphs. The global lower bound is exhaustive only through order four; an equivalent older formulation of the five-node threshold is a residual literature risk.
title: Five vertices are the sharp onset of advantageous-bias seeding switches
